cq_coverage.1: playsInstrument property links Person to Instrument, enabling queries for all instruments played by a Person.
cq_coverage.2: BandMembership pivot class with member (Person), inBand (Band), membershipStart, and membershipEnd enables querying band members at a given time.
cq_coverage.3: BandMembership and hasRole property allow querying a Person's Role in a Band at a specific time.
cq_coverage.4: AlbumRecording pivot class with recordingOf (Album), recordingStart, and recordingEnd data properties covers the album's recording period.
cq_coverage.5: containsTrack property (Album to Track) and trackNumber (Track) allow counting tracks per album.
cq_coverage.6: Album will have a releaseDate data property (xsd:dateTime) for release queries.
cq_coverage.7: TrackSongRelation pivot class with track (Track) and isRecordingOf (Song) enables linking tracks to songs.
cq_coverage.8: Song class has composedOn (xsd:dateTime) for song composition date queries.
cq_coverage.9: Critic class with reviewText (xsd:string) and reviewedAlbum (Album) covers critic statements about records.
cq_coverage.10: Performance class with performanceDate (xsd:dateTime) enables querying performance dates.
cq_coverage.11: PerformanceSong pivot class links Performance to performedSong (Song) for setlists.
cq_coverage.12: Performance has performanceLocation (City) for querying performance locations.
cq_coverage.13: City has inRegion (Region) property for region queries.
cq_coverage.14: Region has inCountry (Country) property for country queries.
cq_coverage.15: containsTrack property with owl:someValuesFrom restriction ensures every Album contains at least one Track.

high_priority_suggestions.suggestion: Refactor Critic class. Make Critic a subclass of Person or use a Review reification pattern with hasReviewer linking to Person. Current design where Critic is disjoint with Person but needs a critic property to link to Person is conceptually flawed.

Add convenience properties for common queries: directlyPlaysInBand (from Person to Band), trackOfSong (from Track to Song), performedInConcert (from Song to Performance). These can be declared as sub-properties or defined via property chains.
